# Hugo Narrow 2.1.4

Patch release for the v2 line. Hugo Narrow is no longer maintained; existing sites should stay on their pinned v2 release.

## Changes

- Removed the foldable-specific layout code. `fold.js` and the viewport-segment media queries no longer constrain content to the first viewport segment or reposition the dock. Foldable devices now use the same breakpoint-based layout as other screens: content may span the hinge, and the dock keeps its normal bottom or side placement.
- `#page-container` now only reads the content width token. The redundant `100vw` clamp and the fold margin override are gone.

## Upgrade

```bash
hugo mod get github.com/tom2almighty/hugo-narrow/v2@v2.1.4
```

No configuration changes are required.
